sources.title: Toward Embodied AGI: A Review of Embodied AI and the Road Ahead - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Definition 1 (Embodied AGI) Embodied AGI is a form of Embodied AI that demonstrates human-like interaction capabilities and can successfully perform diverse, open-ended real-world tasks at a human-level proficiency. In this definition, Embodied AGI is framed as the intersection of AGI and Embodied AI, with an emphasis on human-like settings.
